admission.justification: Fixed-part and location fit are proved by the named passing guard case; as a single-file member it rides the family guarantee.

applicability: Every short form built for an over-bound answer.
conditions: The fixed part is emitted before location and error.
The location rides only while the measured form with it fits 250.
exclusions: Under-bound answers, which carry no short form.
Overlong locations, which are never shortened — the fixed no-path sentence rides instead.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_tool_answer_table.py::ToolAnswerGuardTests (passing in the R6 run); short_form fixed-part measurement unchanged

statement: The fixed part (ok/code/overflow/answerTokens) is never reduced and the exact log location rides only while the measured form with it fits 250; the whole short form is measured against 400 with errorCut, the full original detail preserved beside it.
